tour.bannerBody: We'll show you around your whole dashboard — every page and every tool — in about three minutes.
tour.congratsBody: You've now seen the whole platform. Replay this tour any time from Settings.
tour.replayBody: Take the step-by-step tour again to see where everything is.

overview_actions.title: Quick actions
overview_actions.blurb: Your four most common jobs start here: fund your wallet, add a customer, share your store, and publish your app.

overview_stats.title: Your numbers at a glance
overview_stats.blurb: Customers, orders, revenue and profit — each card shows the total and how it moved in the last 30 days.

overview_revenue.title: Revenue trend
overview_revenue.blurb: A chart of how much you've sold over time, so you can see your store's momentum.

overview_activity.title: Recent activity
overview_activity.blurb: A live feed of orders, customers, transactions and app builds. Click any row to see the details.

nav_wallet.title: Wallet
nav_wallet.blurb: Your money lives here — top it up, watch your balance, and see every transaction.

nav_customers.title: Customers
nav_customers.blurb: Everyone who buys from your store. Add them, search them, and keep their details tidy.

nav_orders.title: Orders
nav_orders.blurb: Every sale made through your store, with its status, amount and the profit you earned.

nav_plans.title: Plans
nav_plans.blurb: The products you sell and the price you sell them at. Turn plans on and set your markup.

nav_store.title: Store
nav_store.blurb: Your storefront's name, logo, colours and theme — everything your customers see.

nav_publishing.title: Publishing
nav_publishing.blurb: Put your store on the Play Store as an Android app your customers can install.

nav_settings.title: Settings
nav_settings.blurb: Your profile, security, notifications — and the option to replay this tour.

wallet_summary.title: Wallet balance
wallet_summary.blurb: Your available balance and what you've earned. This is the money you use to fulfil orders.

virtual_account.title: Your virtual account
virtual_account.blurb: A dedicated account number for receiving customer payments straight into your wallet.

fund_wallet.title: Fund your wallet
fund_wallet.blurb: Add money to your wallet so you always have the float to fulfil orders.

wallet_history.title: Transaction history
wallet_history.blurb: Every credit and debit, with the date, amount and reference — your financial paper trail.

customers_add.title: Add a customer
customers_add.blurb: Create a customer record so you can sell to them and keep their purchase history.

customers_table.title: Customer list
customers_table.blurb: Search by name, filter by status, and edit or remove any customer from the row actions.

orders_table.title: Orders
orders_table.blurb: Track every order's status, amount and profit. Open a row to see the full timeline.

orders_filters.title: Search and filters
orders_filters.blurb: Narrow orders by status or payment method, or search for a customer, plan or reference.

plans_bulk.title: Set your markup
plans_bulk.blurb: Choose a percentage or fixed markup and apply it across all your plans in one go.

plans_list.title: Your plan catalogue
plans_list.blurb: Every plan your store offers, grouped by network, each with its price and the markup you set.

store_tabs.title: Store settings
store_tabs.blurb: Set your store's name, status and welcome message here; branding and theme live in the other tabs.

visit_storefront.title: See your store
visit_storefront.blurb: Open your live storefront to see exactly what your customers see.

publishing_plans.title: Publish your app
publishing_plans.blurb: Pick a publishing plan — local, regional or worldwide — and put your store on the Play Store.

publishing_builds.title: Builds and history
publishing_builds.blurb: Track your app build from queued to completed, download the APK, and browse past builds.

settings_tabs.title: Account settings
settings_tabs.blurb: Update your profile and notification preferences, and control your account security.

settings_security.title: Security
settings_security.blurb: Change your password and manage the devices and sessions signed in to your account.

header_tools.title: Header tools
header_tools.blurb: The bell shows your notifications and the toggle switches between light and dark mode.

congrats.title: You're all set!
congrats.blurb: You've seen everything your store can do. Replay this tour any time from Settings.
